design: reverse SDE (Euler-Maruyama, geometric grid, t_max 3, t_min 0.02, 400 steps after the paired step study), 2000 chains, common Brownian path across arms; arms exact / em_bp (E02a C=8, M in (128, 2048)) / lmmse / isotropic / networks (E03 confirm winners); reference sample 4000 chains from the true law at t_min; 4 seeds
metrics_predeclared: mean log-likelihood under the true P_{t_min} by exact BP evidence (headline) and its gap to the reference sample
status: PRE-REGISTERED (smoke-tested 15 Sep); runs after E02a and E03
